title: Popl vs. iCapture: 2027 feature comparison
summary: Popl vs. iCapture: compare badge scanning, enrichment, dynamic qualifiers, CRM sync, follow-up, and total cost for event teams in 2027.
body_markdown:
Most teams start comparing Popl and iCapture at 1 of 3 moments: a


[badge kit](https://popl.co/blogs/all/what-is-a-badge-kit-api-a-simple-answer-for-non-technical-marketers) failed on the show floor, a spreadsheet took hours to scrub and enrich by hand, or leads forgot the conversation by the time sales followed up.


What do event marketers want instead? An


[event lead capture platform](https://popl.co/pages/event-lead-capture) that works the same way at every show and gets lead info into their CRMs fast enough for sales to act on.


Popl and iCapture both offer a version of this workflow. They scan badges, provide customizable qualifying questions, and sync leads to Salesforce, HubSpot, and the other major CRMs \[1\]. If that were the whole job, this feature comparison would stop here.


The real differences between Popl and iCapture show up in where reps can capture leads, what kind of data those scans return, and how much those capabilities cost.

## How dynamic event lead capture works


Dynamic event lead capture routes every lead based on what they say at the booth. An admin sets the paths before the show, and each answer triggers the next qualifying question, the CRM destination, and the follow-up email. With Popl, the sender address even changes based on the lead’s responses.


Here’s the problem it solves. Field marketers say about half the people a rep scans at a show aren’t prospects. They’re booth traffic: swag seekers, partners, students, competitors.


Yet most event lead capture platforms


[treat every scanned lead the same way](https://popl.co/blogs/all/event-lead-capture-problems-why-most-tools-fail-and-what-to-do-instead) .


Dynamic event lead capture sorts and routes leads automatically:


[hot to sales and warm to nurture campaigns](https://popl.co/blogs/all/what-is-lead-scoring-a-comprehensive-guide-to-understanding-and-implementing) . Booth traffic stays in the scanner.


Popl coined the term Dynamic Event Lead Capture, named for its 4 capabilities: Dynamic Qualifiers, Dynamic CRM Sync, Dynamic Follow-Up Emails, and Dynamic Email Sender.


### Popl: set one Event Flow per show


In Popl, you set Dynamic Event Lead Capture up in the


[Event Flow](https://popl.co/pages/event-flows) Builder. Admins build the questions, sync paths, and follow-up emails, and each email can be sent from the rep who captured the lead or an address you choose. Push a test lead through before doors open, so everything goes as planned at the show.


Need to change something mid-show? Edit the flow.


Event Flows also take the guesswork out of ROI. Every lead is tagged and added to the right Salesforce or HubSpot campaign, so


[attribution shows up where your revenue team already looks](https://popl.co/blogs/all/popl-hubspot-attribution-reporting-guide) . During the show, track leads, meetings, pipeline, and cost per lead in Popl, while reps chase their goals on a live leaderboard.


For the questions your dashboard can’t answer, there’s


[Ask Popl](https://popl.co/pages/ask-popl-ai-assistant) . Popl’s AI assistant works in Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot and reads your Popl event data alongside your CRM’s closed-won revenue. Ask in plain English, and it answers with your numbers.


### iCapture: lead forms plus integration rules


iCapture spreads dynamic capture across a few tools. Admins build a lead form for each event, with custom qualifying questions and skip logic \[5\], then set CRM integration rules to act on the answers. In Cvent’s own playbook, high-intent leads become a Salesforce task, browsers go to a Marketo nurture program, and hidden fields like Event Name tag each lead for attribution \[18\].


Follow-up runs through auto-reply emails or iCapture’s AI email assistant, which writes a different email for every lead based on their form answers \[5\], \[6\]. Admins set the tone and length, then preview a few samples.


Reps can review the AI-generated emails if they have time on the show floor. Otherwise, leads get whatever the chatbot wrote.


If your team already maintains routing rules in the CRM, iCapture’s setup can work. If you want questions, routing, follow-up, and sender in one place you can edit mid-show, that’s what Popl Event Flows are built for.


## Popl vs. iCapture: which event lead capture platform is best for your team in 2027?


Short version: it depends on how many shows you run and who’s paying for the data.


### Quick answer


#### Choose Popl if:


-


You attend many shows a year and want to capture leads at the happy hours, dinners, and offsite activations around them, not just at the booth.


-


You want every scan to come back with a verified email, phone number, title, and company firmographics.


-


You want qualifying questions, CRM sync, and triggered follow-up emails that adapt to the lead, so your team focuses only on high-value opportunities.


-


You want reps to record the conversation and send the summary to your CRM.


-


You want one flat annual price with unlimited users, unlimited events, and unlimited


[badge scans](https://popl.co/blogs/all/how-badge-scanning-technology-works-ocr-qr-and-nfc-explained) .


#### iCapture may fit if:


-


Your team already runs events in the Cvent ecosystem and wants lead capture from the same vendor.


-


Most of your shows support badge kits, you want the organizer’s official registration record from each one, and the kit fee is in the budget \[1\], \[12\], \[13\].


-


You want AI to draft a personalized follow-up email for every lead, and your team has time to read each one before it sends \[6\].


-


You want a kiosk mode, where attendees fill out a questionnaire on a tablet at the booth without a rep \[5\].


## Best for dynamic lead qualification


Popl and iCapture both let admins build custom qualifying questions, and both can show or hide a question based on an earlier answer \[5\]. The difference is what happens after the rep taps an answer.


### The problem with traditional lead qualifiers


Building questions is easy. Getting reps to answer them on a busy show floor is the hard part. Field marketers describe the same failure: too many questions, too many required fields, and an unintuitive form.


### How iCapture solves it


iCapture offers custom questionnaires, “hot lead” question templates, and skip logic that hides questions that don’t apply, so reps only ask what’s relevant \[5\].


### How Popl handles it


Popl uses Dynamic Qualifiers. Pick one question as the branch point, such as role, product interest, or new versus existing customer. Each answer opens only the follow-ups that fit.


A dynamic qualifier supports up to 20 answers with up to 10 follow-ups each. Branching works offline.


Reps don’t have to type, either. AI Recorder can fill qualifiers from a recorded conversation or a quick voice recap, and it never overwrites an answer a rep already entered.


Don’t want to slow reps down? Mark key questions as “Necessary for Completion” instead of “Required.” Reps can save the lead and keep scanning. Popl nudges them to complete it later.


### Who can change the questions


A couple of G2 reviewers say iCapture’s lead forms take work to change. One mentioned contacting iCapture’s team to make sure setup was done right \[8\]. Another wished lead form questions were easier to amend.


iCapture appears to be addressing that with Lead Form Controls: per-event required fields, kiosk settings, and branding. They were on Cvent’s roadmap as of late 2026 \[19\].


In Popl, admins can edit questions mid-show with no ticket.


### What one qualification answer can do


In both platforms, admins set the rules before the show, and a lead’s answers trigger them.


In iCapture, answers on the lead form drive CRM actions through integration rules \[1\].


In a Popl Event Flow, the same answer that branches the questions also picks the CRM destination, the follow-up email, and who that email comes from (the rep who captured the lead or your company address). It’s all set up in one place: Event Flows.


## Best for event-to-CRM data flow


Popl and iCapture both sync natively to Salesforce,


[HubSpot](https://popl.co/pages/hubspot-integration) , Marketo, and Microsoft Dynamics \[1\]. iCapture adds Eloqua \[1\]. Popl adds Pardot, Pipedrive, Zoho, and the rest of its


[30+ integrations](https://popl.co/pages/integrations) .


So the question for CRM admins is simple: do leads arrive complete, in the right place, with an easy fix when something breaks?


### Complete lead records


Most CRM sync and dedupe rules rely on an email, and plenty of badges don’t print one.


Popl enriches every scan with the email, phone number, and company firmographics your CRM needs, so records arrive ready to sync.


Want to hold leads until reps finish qualifying? Add a condition like Completed to your sync path. Those leads wait in Popl, then sync on their own once the info is in.


### The right CRM destination


iCapture routes leads with rules based on answers captured on the floor \[1\].


Popl’s Dynamic CRM Sync routes each lead by its qualifier answers and lead data: hot leads to


[Salesforce](https://popl.co/pages/salesforce-integration) , warm to HubSpot, and anyone who doesn’t qualify stays in Popl. Admins can set up to 10 paths per Event Flow.


### A fix when something breaks


Big show tomorrow, and a lead didn’t sync? Popl’s sync logs show the exact error Salesforce or HubSpot sent back, so admins can fix it without contacting support. Then sync the lead manually or export it to CSV.


Field Manager flags likely sync failures from mismatched field types before they happen. And Priority Fields send a fallback value when your first-choice field is empty.


iCapture’s safety net is its support team, available 24/7 \[8\], \[10\].


## Best for capturing leads anywhere


Picture the sponsor happy hour on night one. Half the room has taken their badges off, and the people your reps most want to meet are at the bar.


A badge-kit scanner doesn’t work here. Field marketers name this moment, along with hosted dinners and offsite events, as exactly where leads slip away.


Not with Popl. Its


[Universal Badge Scanner](https://popl.co/pages/badge-scanner) reads the printed badge with any phone camera, so capture works wherever your reps meet people. The scanner also reads paper business cards and


[LinkedIn QR codes](https://popl.co/blogs/all/how-to-scan-qr-codes) , so a lead without a badge is still a lead.


### iCapture starts with the badge kit


iCapture pulls each show’s registration data through that show’s badge kit \[1\]. Public order forms list developer API kits at $950 to $995 per show as of 2026 \[12\], \[13\], and each kit only reads that event’s badges.


The upside? You get the organizer’s official registration record.


[The downside shows up in the budget](https://popl.co/blogs/all/the-hidden-cost-of-renting-badge-scanners-at-trade-shows) and at the door.


One


[marketing leader](https://popl.co/pages/popl-for-marketing-leaders) said 90% of their shows either didn’t allow iCapture’s scanner or charged extra to connect it. A prospect summed up why Popl made their shortlist: “you don’t have to deal with API kits.”


### What about iCapture’s AI Transcription?


Since January 2026, iCapture’s AI Transcription lets reps photograph a badge or business card and fill in the printed fields, even when a show’s badge API isn’t available \[2\]. That solves the “can’t scan at all” problem.


But transcription only returns what’s printed, and most badges print little more than a name and a company. Popl doesn’t stop at what’s printed. It enriches every scan, even when a badge skips the company name. A job title, location, or LinkedIn profile is enough.


Need the official registration record too? Popl supports badge kits for those shows.


## Best for enrichment without extra costs


Popl and iCapture both enrich leads. The difference is where the data comes from and who pays for it.


### iCapture: bring your own data


iCapture includes company data. Contact enrichment runs through the ZoomInfo or the Apollo license and credits your company already holds \[1\], \[3\].


Already have those accounts? Then enrichment stays in a tool your ops team manages. If you don’t, contact enrichment is a second purchase.


Skip it, and badges that don’t print an email can stall at the CRM. iCapture users describe scans that couldn’t sync to Marketo or Salesforce for exactly that reason, with a spreadsheet and enrichment tools as the fallback.


### Popl: enrichment included on every scan


Popl includes real-time enrichment on every badge scan. No ZoomInfo seats or Apollo subscription required. Here’s what that looks like:


-


Match rates:


[99%+ email find rate](https://popl.co/pages/our-data) and 85%+ mobile find rate on badge scans


-


Speed: a 3- to 15-second response, so data lands before the conversation ends


-


Scale: 1M+ badges scanned, and every scan sharpens the enrichment engine


Behind those numbers are Popl’s 20+ data partners, including


[Apollo](https://popl.co/blogs/all/popl-and-apollo-io-join-forces-to-power-the-data-layer-of-in-person-events) (240M+ contacts and 30M+ companies) and


[RocketReach](https://popl.co/blogs/all/popl-and-rocketreach-announce-category-defining-data-partnership) (700M+ profiles).


### What data comes back on every lead


On the contact side, Popl returns work and personal emails, multiple phone numbers, job title, LinkedIn, and location, plus CRM Insights that flag whether the person is a new lead, an open deal, or a current customer. On the company side, it adds the website, HQ address, size, industry, annual revenue, funding raised, monthly website visitors, and tech stack.


### Verified data, even from sparse badges


Two details matter to the skeptics on your team. First, when a badge skips the company name, Popl can still enrich the lead from the name plus a job title or location, or from a LinkedIn profile. Second, Popl never auto-fills an email it can’t verify.


### Pre-show enrichment


Before the show, List Enrichment


[bulk-enriches a registration or prospect list](https://popl.co/blogs/all/pre-show-list-enrichment-book-meetings-before-the-event-starts) , up to 10,000 rows in a CSV or Excel file.


[Event Intelligence](https://popl.co/pages/event-intelligence) adds the next step: request enriched attendee and exhibitor lists for a conference, then start outreach before doors open.


****


## Best for capturing the conversation in your CRM


Event and field marketers report that staying in the moment can make or break a booth conversation. Typing notes pulls reps out of it, and memory doesn’t hold up either: “I’m taking notes or trying to remember who I was talking to, and it’s gone immediately,” said one rep. With a recording, “you can be more in the conversation.”


Popl’s


[AI Recorder](https://popl.co/pages/ai-voice-recording) captures in-person meetings and sends a summary, key insights, next steps, and seller feedback to the lead record and the CRM.


It collects consent for each lead, works offline, and maps 6 fields to the CRM. It also auto-fills qualifiers from the conversation, so a rep who records doesn’t fill out a form.


Cvent doesn’t document an in-person recording feature for iCapture as of late 2026.


## Best for proving event ROI


Popl and iCapture both report pipeline by event and rep \[1\]. For marketing leaders, that’s table stakes. The budget conversation needs more: which show paid for itself, which rep booked the meetings, and what it cost per lead.


Popl’s Event Flows dashboards report that per event, live, with goals and a rep leaderboard. Because


[Event](https://popl.co/blogs/all/unlocking-event-roi-how-popl-transforms-salesforce-into-an-in-person-lead-generation-machine)[Flows map to Salesforce](https://popl.co/blogs/all/unlocking-event-roi-how-popl-transforms-salesforce-into-an-in-person-lead-generation-machine)


and HubSpot campaigns, the attribution carries into the CRM instead of living in a separate tool.


Then Ask Popl,


[Popl’s MCP-based assistant](https://popl.co/blogs/all/popl-launches-worlds-first-ai-assistant-for-events-in-anthropic-s-claude) , answers the question your CFO asks, like “Did this show pay for itself?” or “Which events created the most pipeline this year?”


Ask it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and it answers using live Popl and CRM data, including closed-won.


One Popl customer, RapidSOS,


[captured 1,690 qualified leads across 10 events](https://popl.co/pages/rapidsos-case-study) , averaging 9 seconds from badge scan to HubSpot. As their team put it, Popl helped them “realize significant cost savings, potentially thousands of dollars per major event.”


## Built for busy event calendars


If your team runs 20 shows a year across 2 or 3 regional subteams, setup time is the hidden cost of any lead capture tool. That’s one reason field marketers say they want one system “show to show,” with no rebuilding.


In Popl, one Event Flow runs each show: capture, qualifiers, sync, and follow-up. Planning a full season? Import your event calendar by CSV and build every flow from one template, or copy an existing flow with its settings.


Regional subteams get their own forms, and admins keep control across all of them.


iCapture’s lead forms are built per event with rules-based routing \[1\]. iCapture users say it keeps leads centralized in one place across shows, which is the main reason they chose it.

Popl Unlimited is one flat annual price with unlimited users, unlimited events, and unlimited badge scans. Enrichment is included on every scan, and no badge kit is required. Request a[custom quote](https://popl.co/pages/pricing) .

## Popl vs. iCapture: the bottom line for 2027


Popl and iCapture both let admins capture leads dynamically. Popl takes it further. Event Flows give admins one place to set up and fine-tune every show: the questions reps ask, the CRM path each lead takes, the follow-up email, and the address it sends from.


On top of that, capture works anywhere your reps meet people. For high-volume event teams with busy calendars and pipeline targets to beat, that’s the more complete, flexible platform.


See how Popl captures leads dynamically and enriches them in seconds.

## Frequently asked questions


#### What’s the difference between Popl and iCapture?


Popl reads any badge with a phone camera, and qualifiers, CRM routing, and follow-up emails adapt to each lead’s answers. iCapture pulls official registration data through each show’s badge kit \[1\].


#### Is Popl a good iCapture alternative?


Popl is a


[strong iCapture alternative](https://popl.co/blogs/all/trade-show-badge-scanner-app-what-to-look-for-in-2026) for teams that want capture to work at every show without badge kits, with dynamic follow-up included. Popl is one of G2’s Best Software Products of 2026 \[14\].


#### When is iCapture the better choice?


iCapture fits teams already running events in the Cvent ecosystem whose shows support badge kits.


#### Does iCapture include lead enrichment?


iCapture includes company data. Contact enrichment runs through your own ZoomInfo seats and credits or your own Apollo subscription \[1\], \[3\]. Popl includes enrichment on every scan, with a 99%+ email find rate.


#### How much does iCapture cost compared to Popl?


iCapture starts at about $8,000 per year, quote-only, plus a badge kit at each show where you want registration data \[8\], \[12\], \[13\]. Popl is one flat annual price, quote-based. The pricing table above breaks down both.


#### How easy is it to adopt Popl?


Reps use one Popl app on their own phones at every show, and it holds 4.8 stars on the App Store and Google Play \[15\], \[16\]. G2 rates Popl 9.2 for ease of setup.


[Onboarding and implementation](https://popl.co/pages/onboarding-event-lead-capture) take up to 1 month and are included on certain enterprise plans \[8\]. Smaller teams that want more hands-on help can add dedicated onboarding.


#### How easy is it to bring my iCapture setup over to Popl?


Import your events from HubSpot, Salesforce, or CSV, and


[map your existing CRM fields](https://popl.co/blogs/all/how-to-instantly-sync-popl-leads-and-map-properties-to-hubspot) , so your sales process doesn’t change. Many teams time the move with their iCapture renewal, and Popl can run alongside iCapture at shows where a badge kit is already paid for.
